 Manchester United (1-3-4) and Chelsea (4-3-1) will face off today at 8:30 a.m. ET at Stamford Bridge in London, with both teams seeking a crucial Premier League victory.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chelsea is favored at a -120 price, with the over/under set at 2.5 (-170o / +135u) goals.
 Let's get into our Manchester United vs. Chelsea prediction .
 Manchester United vs. Chelsea Prediction
 Picks: Chelsea to Win (-120), Over 2.5 Goals (-170) & Cole Palmer Anytime Scorer (+170) 
My Manchester United vs. Chelsea best bets are a home win in a match that will feature over 2.5 goals, as both defenses currently allow too many quality opportunities, and with Cole Palmer at favorable odds to score.
 Manchester United vs. Chelsea Odds
 Manchester United vs. Chelsea Betting Analysis
 Both clubs desperately need a positive result to salvage their seasons. Manchester United sit near the bottom of the Premier League table with only seven points from eight matches. This marks their lowest point total at this stage since 1986.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Head coach Michael Carrick faces intense pressure to deliver a victory. The locker room lacks chemistry, highlighted by recent public disputes between players like Bruno Fernandes and the staff. The team failed to record a shutout in 11 of 12 matches across all competitions. They remain winless in their last eight matches, consistently producing a lower expected goals total than their opponents.
 Chelsea also experience significant instability. Head coach Xabi Alonso continues to search for his best lineup and tactical formation. The recent switch to a 4-3-2-1 system resulted in a disappointing 2-0 home loss to Tottenham.
 The Blues surrender too many goals, with 15 allowed so far this campaign. They gave up two or more goals in three of their four home matches at Stamford Bridge.
 First-choice goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez remains unavailable due to injury, which forces backup Penders into action and further weakens their defensive unit. Furthermore, Chelsea lost 14 matches since the start of March, the most of any team in Europe's top five leagues over that span.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Historically, these teams play competitive affairs. They average 2.8 goals over their last five head-to-head encounters. Manchester United won both matchups last season, including a 1-0 victory at Stamford Bridge. However, Chelsea won two of the last three home matches against the Red Devils prior to that.
 Both offenses usually find success against each other, with both teams on the scoresheet in three of their last five meetings. With both defenses in poor form and without key personnel, expect plenty of offensive action and multiple goals on Saturday.
 Check out the best soccer odds before making your Manchester United vs Chelsea picks .
 Manchester United vs. Chelsea Picks, Parlay
 Leg 1: Chelsea to Win (-120) 
 Leg 2: Over 2.5 Goals (-170) 
 Leg 3: Cole Palmer Anytime Goalscorer (+170) 
 Chelsea have one of the most dangerous attacks in the Premier League, and they face a Manchester United side that have been woeful defensively of late. As a result, we expect the home side to win this game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chelsea have scored 17 league goals thus far, a tally only bested by Brighton and Manchester City. They failed to score against Tottenham last weekend, but they have still netted 11 goals across four Premier League matches at Stamford Bridge under Xabi Alonso.
 In that sense, there is an opportunity on the total goals market. Manchester United face severe defensive issues. The Red Devils surrendered three goals to Bournemouth recently and four to Como prior to that. They allow an average of 1.70 expected goals against per match. Opponents consistently create high-quality chances against them.
 It is true that Chelsea lack striker Joao Pedro due to injury. But this absence elevates Cole Palmer in the goalscorer markets. Palmer tallied a hat-trick against Manchester United last season. He also serves as the primary penalty taker. Since Palmer rested during the midweek cup tie due to a red card suspension, he will take the field with fresh legs.
 Palmer already attempted 25 shots this season, with seven on target. He will confidently attack a vulnerable Manchester United defense. Back Palmer to score at plus-money.
